My dear [Mr Macmillan](../persons.html#939)

It is an odd doubt, but I am not sure whether it was you or [Mr Craik](../persons.html#379) who wrote to me about writing a History to suit that proof.

Am I to understand that I may take [the wars](../books.html#126) of the Castilhians [sic] and Moors, for I should like to make it my winter work

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: Black-edged paper.
